description: Unified Cross-Dataset Behavioral Taxonomy for Ransomware Early Warning

FILE_OPERATIONS.description: High-frequency file creation, modification, encryption overwrite, and rename events
FILE_OPERATIONS.RanSAP_mapping: ata_write.csv burst rate, write/read block count ratio
FILE_OPERATIONS.AD_Early_Stage_mapping: EventID 4663 (Object Access / File Write), Sysmon Event 11 (FileCreate)

STORAGE_ENTROPY.description: Information entropy spikes in written storage sectors indicative of encryption payloads

PROCESS_ACTIVITY.description: Rapid process spawning, injection, and execution of command interpreters
PROCESS_ACTIVITY.RanSAP_mapping: Not directly observable in ATA block layer
PROCESS_ACTIVITY.RanSMAP_mapping: Memory bus access frequency spikes during process execution
PROCESS_ACTIVITY.AD_Early_Stage_mapping: EventID 4688 (Process Creation with CommandLine), Sysmon Event 1

SYSTEM_REGISTRY.description: Persistence mechanisms, volume enumeration, shadow copy deletion, autoruns
SYSTEM_REGISTRY.RanSAP_mapping: Observed indirectly as metadata sector modifications

NETWORK_LATERAL.description: Lateral SMB enumeration, remote service execution, C2 communication
NETWORK_LATERAL.RanSAP_mapping: Not observable at local storage layer
NETWORK_LATERAL.AD_Early_Stage_mapping: EventID 4624 (Logon Type 3 - Network), EventID 5140 (Network Share Object Access)
